explication: easyeda-agent automates EasyEDA Pro designs through an AI-facing CLI/MCP interface, a local daemon, and an in-editor connector using the official EDA API. The main workflow is request → typed action dispatch → host reads and writes → verification, with schematic, PCB, library, and delivery capabilities. The README documents the overall integration; sampled source confirms the CLI entry, connector transport/context, MCP forwarding, and selected layout/solver internals. Other domain links are documented capability-level relationships, not claims that unsampled files were inspected.
